label: Construction begins
note: Caravan house raised by a salt-merchants' guild (fictional).

label: Plaster renewed
note: The guild repaints the hall and the gate relief.

label: Earthquake
note: Cracks the arch; the south-west tower loses its roof.

label: Fire
note: The door and the roof beams burn.

label: Abandoned
note: The last caretaker leaves; weathering accelerates.

label: Shelling
note: The north-east tower top, two columns and most of the vault are lost.

label: Emergency shoring
note: Timber props placed under the gate arch.
